rv.q: I was a skeptic going in, but Mrs. Doubtfire proved to be an undeniably charming production that is a great launch for the 2024-2025. Fox Cities Performing Arts Center Broadway Across America season.
Nevertheless, it's an enjoyable show that both pays homage to the movie — with some lines written word-for-word — and develops its own characters and storytelling.

cn.t: The touring production of "Mrs. Doubtfire" charms with technical wizardry—including 31 lightning-fast costume changes—and delivers both heartfelt family story and laugh-out-loud comedy that captivates audiences.
